scripts.forever-monolith: rm -f /tmp/forever.log; knex migrate:latest && yarn forever-api && yarn forever-worker && yarn forever-subscribers && tail -f /tmp/forever.log
scripts.dev: NODE_ENV=local knex migrate:latest && NODE_ENV=local node . | bunyan
scripts.debug: NODE_ENV=local knex migrate:latest && NODE_ENV=local node --inspect --inspect-brk . | bunyan
scripts.dev-worker: NODE_ENV=local knex migrate:latest && NODE_ENV=local node worker.js | bunyan
scripts.dev-subscribers: NODE_ENV=local knex migrate:latest && NODE_ENV=local node subscribers.js | bunyan
scripts.watch: NODE_ENV=local knex migrate:latest && NODE_ENV=local nodemon -e js,json,yaml . | bunyan
scripts.watch-workers: NODE_ENV=local knex migrate:latest && NODE_ENV=local nodemon -e js,json,yaml worker.js | bunyan
scripts.watch-subscribers: NODE_ENV=local knex migrate:latest && NODE_ENV=local nodemon -e js,json,yaml subscribers.js | bunyan
scripts.test: rm -rf ./coverage && mkdir coverage && TZ=utc NODE_ENV=test API_ENVIRONMENT=test mocha --reporter mocha-junit-reporter
scripts.test:ci: rm -rf ./coverage && mkdir coverage && TZ=utc NODE_ENV=test API_ENVIRONMENT=test nyc mocha --reporter mocha-junit-reporter --exit
scripts.seed: NODE_ENV=local knex migrate:latest && NODE_ENV=local knex seed:run
scripts.git:clean: git clean -d -f; git branch --merged | grep -v \* | xargs git branch -D; git fsck; git gc --prune=now
scripts.docker-stop: docker kill `docker ps -q` || true; docker rm -f `docker ps -a -q` || true; docker network prune -f || true
scripts.docker-clean: yarn docker-stop; docker rmi -f `docker images -q` || true
scripts.list-wkfls: aws swf list-open-workflow-executions --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 --region ${REGION:-'us-east-2'} --domain wkfl-local --start-time-filter oldestDate=1,latestDate=$(date +%s)
scripts.list-run-ids: aws swf list-open-workflow-executions --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 --region ${REGION:-'us-east-2'} --domain wkfl-local --start-time-filter oldestDate=1,latestDate=$(date +%s) | jq '.executionInfos | map({RUN_ID: .execution.runId, WKFL_ID: .execution.workflowId})'
scripts.poll-decisions: aws swf poll-for-decision-task --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 --region ${REGION:-'us-east-2'} --domain wkfl-local --task-list name=DEFAULT_TASK_LIST
scripts.poll-activities: aws swf poll-for-activity-task --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 --region ${REGION:-'us-east-2'} --domain wkfl-local --task-list name=DEFAULT_TASK_LIST
